title: Prop Firm Tracker
subtitle: Manage your prop firm challenges and track progress
noChallenges: No challenges yet. Create your first prop firm challenge to start tracking.
linkMt5Description: Connect a MetaTrader 5 account for automated daily tracking
selectMt5Hint: Select an MT5 account to auto-fill balance and currency, and enable automated daily tracking. Skip this step for manual tracking.
selectPropFirmPresetDesc: Choose a preset or configure a custom challenge
maxDailyLoss: Max daily loss: {{value}} (based on starting balance)
ddBalance: Balance-based — resets from daily starting balance
ddTrailingBalance: Trailing (balance) — DD floor rises with profit
ddTrailingEquity: Trailing (equity) — DD floor rises with equity HWM
ddStaticDesc: Drawdown limit measured from your initial account balance — never changes.
ddBalanceDesc: Daily drawdown measured from each day's opening balance.
ddEquityDesc: Drawdown measured from real-time equity (includes floating P&L).
ddTrailingBalanceDesc: Max drawdown floor rises as your balance grows — locks profits into your safety net.
ddTrailingEquityDesc: Max drawdown floor rises with your equity high-water mark — most restrictive type.
alwaysTrails: Always trails — DD floor continues rising indefinitely
locksAtBreakeven: Locks at breakeven — stops trailing once floor reaches initial balance
alwaysTrailsDesc: The drawdown floor keeps rising as you profit. This is the strictest trailing mode.
locksAtBreakevenDesc: The trailing floor stops moving once it reaches your initial balance — you can't lose the initial capital.
minTradingDaysHint: e.g. 4 — minimum days you must trade
maxTradingDaysHint: e.g. 30 — calendar days allowed for the challenge
endDateHint: Leave blank to auto-calculate from start + max days
maxSingleDayDesc: No single day can contribute more than this % of your total profit target.
maxAllowedDailyProfit: Max allowed daily profit: {{value}} per day
maxSingleDayHint: e.g. 40 means your best day can't exceed 40% of the profit target
phaseLinkInfo: When this phase is passed, a new challenge will be created for the next phase with inherited rules and carried-over equity.
warnProfitOverDD: Profit target is larger than max drawdown — this challenge has unfavorable risk-reward.
warnMinOverMax: Min trading days cannot exceed max trading days.
warnEndDateShort: End date allows only {{days}} calendar days, but max trading days is {{max}}.
challengeCreatedDesc: Your prop firm challenge has been set up.
resetsAtClose: Resets at broker day close (00:00 server time)
tradingDayHint: A trading day is counted when at least one trade is executed
logDailyAutoDesc: Daily results are automatically recorded from your MT5 account. You can still log manually if needed.
aiRiskDesc: Check trade risk against your challenge rules before entering
verdictSafe: Trade complies with all challenge rules
allLimitsSafe: All drawdown limits and rules are within safe parameters.
mt5LiveDesc: Real-time position monitoring against challenge rules
sampleReplacedHint: Once you connect MT5 and create a real challenge, this card will be replaced by your live progress.
